question: If there are ground dragons and water dragons, then are there wind dragons and fire dragons as well? Doesn’t the thought of a shadow dragon or light dragon set your imagination afire?
answer: There are winged dragons, but they’re not in the categories of wind dragon or fire dragon, you see. Out of the types of mabeasts that can use magic, breathing fire is fairly popular. In the past, there was one known as an evil dragon, but it was dealt with. By Mr. Club Wielder.
